content.rendered:
The SCS Virtual Back to School Night will take place on October 1st. On the morning of October 1st, you will receive an email with an informational video from Principal Joy Raboli, the School Board and the Parent Advisory Committee to view at your convenience, along with instructions on how to join a live session with your student’s teacher that same evening. This event is intended for parent and guardians only to learn all about the class curriculum.

We hope to see you attend!
